tei:div.tei:p: "!# gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro snying gi thig le las: gsang ba rdo rje gro lod hūm̐ sgrub zab mo bar chad kun sel bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ dpal rdo rje gro lod rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo:1$0000250 ye shes mkha' 'gro snying gi thig le las: rdo rje gro lod hūm̐ sgrub zab mo ni: skad cig tsam gyis dran rdzogs gsal bar bya:1$0000300 hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: kun gzhi sems nyid ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang: 'od gsal lhun grub rdo rje gro bo lod: sku mdog dmar smug zhal nas mtshon 'brum 'thor: spyan gsum sdang mig nam mkha'i dbyings la gzigs: zhal gdangs gangs ri'i tshems gtams bzhad pa'i nyams: ljags 'dril ā ral+li yi hūm̐ sgra sgrog: ag tshom smin ma me dpung ltar mched 'bar: dbu skra kham nag gyen brdzes rus rgyan spras: za 'og ber phod chos gos sku la gsol: phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa: raṃ dgu dang ni hūm̐ dgus mtshan pa yis: dngos po thams cad skad cig tsam gyis 'joms: g.yon pas lcags phur sku gsum ngo bo ste: gang la gsor kyang gnyis med rang bzhin 'dul: thabs shes dbyer med zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul: 'gying bag rol pa'i gar stabs ling ling mdzad: bdud dang bar chad ma lus zil gyis gnon: rngam brjid rab khros sku las ye shes me'i: tshwa tshwa 'khyug cing 'ur chem hūm̐ sgra sgrog: khams gsum 'jig rten dbang med g.yo zhing 'dar: snang ba thams cad rang 'od las grub pa'i: 'ja' zer rdo rje gro lod rang bzhin la: 'od gang khyab brdal lhun grub chen por gyur: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ yig dmar po las: hūm̐ dmar dpag tu med par nam mkhar 'phros: bar snang sa gzhi phyogs mtshams ris med pa: stong gsum 'jig rten ma lus hūm̐ gis khengs: ࿌ de la hrīḥbarjod dpag med hūm̐ rnams kun: mkha' 'gror gyur nas kun kyang hūm̐ sgra sgrog: phyi nang gsang ba'i bde gshegs byang sems dang: skye 'gro pho mo rtsi shing nags tshal dang: snang srid lha 'dre gnod byed gdug sems can: tshe dang srog gi bar gcod thams cad kyang:

dhā kir gyur nas kun kyang hūm̐ sgra ldir: de nas bdag gi mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus: hūm̐ dmar gsal la hūm̐ hūm̐ drag po yis: dhā ki ma kun bro brdung gar stabs shig: stong gsum ri rab dang bcas 'ur chem 'degs: ma lus bdag gi dbang du 'dus par bsam: ࿌ tshogs drug gzugs snang gang shar thams cad kun: shar grol chos nyid rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐:1$0000250 de ltar sum bsgril dang ni bdun bsgril sbyar:1$0000300 brtul zhugs drag po srin po'i ngar dbyangs dang: gtum sgra rdo rje drag po'i 'gying glur bcas: hūm̐ sgra brtsegs ma ngar ldan thog ltar bzla: dal bus bzla na 'brug dbyangs ldir ba ltar: dal khug ngur sgra dkyus su phab la bzla: rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i klong yangs nas: byin 'bebs gar dbyangs gsol 'debs dang bcas pa: 'di ltar byas pas ya ki kun bzang nas: ma ki 'jag ma'i srin bu yan chad kyi: bar chad kun zhi gang dang gang gnas khang: bkra shis byin chags zil 'od snum zhag ldan: las ngan sgrib pa kun byang tshe bsod rgyas: dngos sam nyams su ye shes dhā ki 'du: yid bzhin nor ltar mchod cing bkur bar byed: snang srid bka' nyan lha 'dres srog snying phul: khyad par dgra bgegs 'byung po brlag par 'gyur: bag dro nyams 'bar lus ni rngul zhing 'dar: saṃskṛ'i skad 'don rdzu 'phrul ya zung ston: yi dam zhal mthong mkha' 'gros lung ston 'gyur: chos nyid skye med lhag mthong rgyud la 'char: nyams myong dam chos kun la rang byan tshud: tshe rabs dran dang shes rab spobs pa skye: chos rnams ma bslabs rang bzhin shes par 'gyur: mdor na las bzhi gang la 'jug kyang rung: nyin zhag re la thugs kyi snying po 'di: nyis khri gcig stong zhag gcig bsnyen grangs rdzogs: ngal bso'i dus su rtsol bral ngang du bzhag: rtags rnams rdzogs nas dngos grub blang ba ni:

dngos po nor rdzas tshogs kyi mchod par bsham: zhal zas phun tshogs spyan gzigs zhim po rnams: mdun du bkram pa'i gtor ma chen po ni: rat+na 'bar ba'i dbyibs la tshogs kyis bskor: dar zab 'phan gdugs bla res rgyan du bres: rdo rje slob dpon yi dam dhā ki la: ser sna med pa'i tshogs mchod dus bzhir phul: dngos grub blang ba'i snying po bzlas pa dang: gus pas bstod cing gang 'dod gsol ba gdab: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ba su nā nā kha dhe sid+dhi sarba sid+dhi dha na me dhi hrī: ā yuḥsid+dhi sa ma ya sdus sdus: bzlas shing 'jig rten khams kyi 'dod yon lnga: 'od kyis bsdus nas tshogs rdzas rnams la bstim: 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i pho brang dang: rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad: rtsi dang 'bru sman rin chen bdud rtsi'i bcud: thams cad ma lus bsdus shing bstim par dmigs: rgyal ba rnams dang rig 'dzin slob dpon gyis: tshe yi dngos grub bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs: gsol ba gdab cing 'chi med bdud rtsir bsam: phud la rol pas dngos grub tshe la dbang: lan gcig bsgrubs na sid+dhi rnam gnyis thob: 'chi med rig 'dzin go 'phang the tshom med: khyad chos bla med 'di 'dra ngo mtshar che: skal ldan snying la chongs shig sa ma yā: khathaṃ: yang gsang hūm̐ gi rtags rdzogs nas: gzhan la byin rlabs byed 'dod pas: gnas gtsang maṇ+ḍal dri chus byug: tshom bu bzhi dang mchod gtor bsham: las gzhung bzlas pa dang bcas bya: de nas bum chus slob ma bkru: bgegs bskrad srung 'khor maṇ+ḍal phul: gsol ba 'di skad lan gsum gdab: ho: bde gshegs rgyal ba thams cad kyi: ngo bo rdo rje gro lod rtsal: bdag cag 'dir 'dus dad ldan la: byin rlabs dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol: brgyud khungs zab pa'i lo rgyus bshad: de nas skyabs sdom gnang ba ni: ho: skal ldan skyes bu khyed rnams kun:

dal 'byor thob pa grangs mang yang: gsang sngags zab mo'i sgor zhugs dkon: de nyid bsod nams tshogs las byung: slar yang zab mo'i gdams ngag nyon: bla ma lha la gsol btab ni: na mo bde gshegs spyan snga ru: sngon chad bag med las smin rnams: deng nas byang bar mdzad du gsol: phyin chad sgo gsum nyid la 'bul: legs nyes thams cad khyed rang shes: slob ma lhar gsal ye shes bstim: spos rol dbyangs bcas 'di skad bskul: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhengs shig pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: bdag cag mos pa'i bu rnams la: byin rlabs 'beb phyir gnas 'dir byon: 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon rje: khyad par thugs rjes bod la dgongs: las ngan rnam smin mnar ba yi: bdag cag rjes 'jug bu slob rnams: thugs kyis 'dor ram gu ru rje: thugs rjes yal yol btang snyoms na: yang sangs rgyas pa'i dgos pa ci: bdag cag gdung ba'i mchi ma 'khrugs: gsol 'debs snying nas 'o dod 'bod: pha mchog khyod kyi yon tan dran: bu la gzigs shig thugs rje can: byin gyis rlobs shig sprul pa'i sku: lus la sku yi byin phob cig: bde ba spor cig dhā ki'i tshogs: ngag la gsung gi byin phob cig: nus pa skyed cig yi dam lha: sems la thugs kyi byin phob cig: rtogs pa spor cig gu ru rje: 'dir tshogs mos pa'i bu rnams la: yon tan phrin las byin phob cig: lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyongs: rtsa gsum dam tshig nyams pa skongs: sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs: dug lnga'i rnam rtog zhi bar mdzod: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog skur: lha srin sde brgyad dam la thogs: mi mthun rkyen sol mthun pa sgrubs: mchog dang thun mong byin phob cig: ces dang hūm̐ gsum hūm̐ bdun bsgril: mang bar brjod cing lus gar bsgyur: mngon sum byin pheb rtags byung nas: su pra tiṣ+ṭhas me tog 'thor: de nas bum pa spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐:

brda don bum pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dis: rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: sgo gsum dri ma bag chags dag: gro lod rtsal dang dbyer med shog: skabs 'dir hūm̐ gsum hūm̐ bdun brtsegs: gtor ma tsaka li spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐: sgyu 'phrul sku gzugs ba liṃ dbang: rigs kyi bu la byin 'beb na: snang stong rdo rje'i sku 'grub nas: kun khyab kun byed dbang thob shog: hūm̐ bsgril bzla ba gong bzhin 'gre: bgrang phreng lag gtad hūm̐ bzlas nas: hūm̐: brjod bya'i tshig dbang hūm̐ 'di yin: bde gshegs kun gyi yang snying hūm̐: rigs kyi bu la hūm̐ bstims pas: grags stong gsung dbyangs dbang thob shog: hūm̐ 'gres: sna tshogs rdo rje snying gar bzhag: hūm̐: phrin las bzhi sgrub rgya gram dbang: rigs kyi bu la 'di gtad pas: rig pa rtsal dbang thob gyur nas: gro lod rtsal dang dbyer med shog: hūm̐ 'gres: gser gyi rdo rje lag g.yas gtad: hūm̐: gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu 'di: nam yang 'bral med 'chang bar bya: don la rang rig rang gsal brda: thabs shes dbyer med dbang thob shog: hūm̐ bzla: lcags kyi phur pa lag g.yon gtad: hūm̐: sku gsum rang bzhin lcags phur 'di: rigs kyi bu la 'di gtad pas: phyi nang bar chad rdul du rlog: dug gsum bsgral ba'i dbang thob shog: hūm̐ bzla: de nas tshogs dang maṇ+ḍal phul: rjes kyi bya ba spyi ltar bya: sa ma ya: khaṃtha: yang gsang hūm̐ gi rtags rdzogs nas: las tshogs rim pa bya 'dod na: gnas lngar rang mdog hūm̐ yig gsal: de nas snang srid yid yul kun: bde chen 'khor lor rang rig hūm̐: hūm̐ dkar dri med rdo rje 'bar: hūm̐ las hūm̐ 'phros hūm̐ sgra sgrog: hūm̐ gis nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi: longs spyod 'khor lor rang rig hūm̐: hūm̐ dmar dri med lcags kyu 'bar: hūm̐ las hūm̐ 'phros hūm̐ sgra sgrog: hūm̐ gis lha 'dre mi gsum sdud: chos kyi 'khor lor rang rig hūm̐:

hūm̐ sngon dri med 'od zer 'bar: hūm̐ las hūm̐ 'phros hūm̐ sgra sgrog: hūm̐ gis las kun lhun gyis grub: sprul pa'i 'khor lor rang rig hūm̐: hūm̐ ser dri med rin chen 'bar: hūm̐ las hūm̐ 'phros hūm̐ sgra sgrog: hūm̐ gis tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas: bde skyong 'khor lor rang rig hūm̐: hūm̐ ljang dri med mtshon me 'bar: hūm̐ las hūm̐ 'phros hūm̐ sgra sgrog: hūm̐ gis dgra bgegs gdug pa thul: nus thon hūm̐ bsgrag gar dbyangs bcas: dbang bskur rgyun khyer nyer gcig re: gzhan yang yid la ci 'dod pa: yi ge hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du bya: hūm̐ sgra sgrog cing dmigs pa dang: byams dang snying rje'i nus pas bsgyur: ci 'dod 'bras bu 'phral du 'grub: des na hūm̐ yig grangs med spros: shar lho dang ni nub byang dbus: phyogs mtshams thams cad hūm̐ sgras bkang: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes 'brug ltar sgrog: rang sems hūm̐ dang dbyer med bsres: bskyed rdzogs gnyis med klong yangs ngang: ma bcos lhug pa'i yi ge hūm̐: 'di nyid kho na bsnyen sgrub mchog: bla ma'i gsang sgrub yang gsang hūm̐: 'bru gcig a ti'i khyad chos yin: 'di la dmigs pa 'khrul 'khor dang: gar dbyangs phyag rgya'i chos skor rnams: sgrub dus dhā kis dngos su ston: ma 'ongs skal ldan bu rnams kyis: bla ma rnams la gsol 'debs dang: hūm̐ sgra gsum bsgril bdun bsgril sprad: de bzhin yi dam mkha' 'gro dang: chos skyong rnams la gsol 'debs dang: hūm̐ sgra gsum bsgril bdun bsgril sprad: byin 'beb smon lam bzang po dang: bkra shis bde legs gsol 'debs dang: hūm̐ sgra gsum bsgril bdun bsgril sprad: rgya che grangs mang bka' lung don: bla ma'i man ngag dag la 'dus: de yang zab gter dpag med kyang: gsang ba'i yang gsang 'bru gcig 'di: bdag 'dra pad+ma'i srog sgrub yin: o rgyan nga yi yon tan kun:

'bru gcig 'di la brten nas byung: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams: 'bru gcig 'di la nan gyis sgrubs: 'di yis mi bslu ci bsam 'grub: du ma ro gcig snying thig 'di: ma 'ongs las can dpal du shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: khaṃtha gu h+ya: zhes bdag 'dra pad+ma bde chen gling pas dre phu brag ri zhun mkhar nas gdan drangs pa'o/// /
